title: The Novelist 2.1.1 (tester build)
notes:
Tester build of The Novelist 2.1.1. It is marked as a pre-release, so installed copies stay on 2.1.0 until this build is published as the latest release.

Direct download: https://github.com/Mike-CloudForest/the-novelist-releases/releases/download/v2.1.1/The-Novelist-Setup-2.1.1.exe

New since 2.1.0:
- New books ask for a title and pen name and are saved from the first word.
- Book Setup finds titled names such as "Captain Ashworth" and leaves places unticked. Renaming a character can change the name everywhere in the book.
- Proofreading lists name the chapter of each finding, and a click jumps to the word with its fix open.
- Ghostwriter says where a draft will go and how many drafts are left today.
- The license screen says why a key failed, and a computer that was removed can activate again.
- Keyboard menus, a clearer focus ring and a steady text cursor.
- Print PDFs embed their page-number font, so KDP accepts them.
